judgment.notes: A001 instantiates M003 with V=R, a=-R, b=R, f=fline and d=dline. The real codomain is complete; R>0 gives ordered endpoints; smooth g gives continuity and the stated coordinate derivative; continuous dline on the compact interval is integrable. Its endpoint values vanish because the faces lie outside C. A002 instantiates M004 with the remaining-coordinate and j-coordinate restricted Lebesgue measures, V=R and f=v. Both measures are finite and thus s-finite, and v is continuous and bounded on their compact support, hence integrable. S003 supplies the measure identification under I_j, including the mass-one R^0 factor when n=1. The supplied conclusions give exactly F002 and F003. No E application occurs.

scope: Coverage is reviewer-reported; reading alone is not mathematical assessment.
